title: Book One · Chapter 172: The Evening before the Doors Open
story:
The stool stands beside the kitchen door. Mum has put a clean cloth over its seat. The blue bag hangs from the hook above it. Her card and three light books are ready inside.

Ronan has only a small list left at home. Bring the school bag. Meet the others. Help with labels. Keep the route clear. He reads the list of things for school. Other people have their names beside those things. He will carry only his own light bag.

Mum and Leo's mother are at the gate. They read the plan together once more. Half past one tomorrow. They will bring the stool to school together. They will help clear the room. Then they will take it home again. Mr Qiu has his empty pencil box and pad ready. His table will close early in the afternoon. He has a sign to tell his customers.

Mrs Lan says she plans to come for a short visit. She will use the chair if her legs need a rest. Then she asks everyone to stop standing in her clear path. They move at once, and she laughs.

Dad comes home when the light is nearly gone. He washes, eats, and reads Ronan's little list. The work at Mr Sun's is still booked. He must work until at least three. He may need to stay later.

“I will try to get to you,” he says.

Ronan nods. He has kept MAY COME LATE on the visitors list. He does not change it while Dad is looking at him.

“The room is beyond the hall,” he says. “Mum knows the way. Miss Wu can help you find me.”

Dad puts the invitation back in his pocket. “Good.”

After supper Ronan goes to the low shelf. The wooden boat is there. One end is still green and the other is grey-blue. The red-sail book is beside it. The old-home drawing and the private card are safe between their boards. None of them is going into tomorrow's room.

He picks up the bell. He presses it once, softly. It rings in the little kitchen. The sound goes out into the yard.

“Dinner was an hour ago,” Mum says.

“Perhaps tomorrow's dinner.”

“Then it is very early.”

He smiles and puts the bell back. There is no new bicycle outside the gate. His saved money is still in its box. Mum and Dad still have their birthday gift money set aside. They will look for a bike after River Street Day. They will check it carefully. Then they can decide to buy it. A bright colour is not enough.

Dad sits beside him for a moment. “Are you worried?” he asks Ronan.

“A little. What if people don't like it?”

“You can show them your work. Let them look. Then you can ask for their thoughts.”

Ronan thinks about Mei's curtain picture and the joke door. He thinks of Mum's wide bag handles. The stool is ready under its cloth too. He likes those things himself. He wants other people to like them too. He can ask the visitors tomorrow. Tonight he cannot know all their answers. He cannot check that part tonight.

He leaves one line blank. He can write any changes there during setup. Then he shuts the book. Beyond the green gate the street is growing quiet. The school doors are still closed. Tomorrow people may come through those doors. Tonight Ronan puts his book by the bed. He looks out at the familiar yard. He knows each door and the little pot. He tells Mum and Dad good night. He does not ask them any more questions. Then he gets into bed by the window.

---

重点表达：set aside＝专门留出；familiar＝熟悉的；setup＝布置准备。

情节提示：labels＝标签；route＝行走路线；set aside＝专门留出。

理解：1. 哪些东西还留在家中，为什么？2. Dad 对到场作出了怎样的实际承诺？
